scope: Bounded read-only review of standalone source-selection admission extension and conservation checks, not State Pension legal assessment or runtime adoption.

findings.finding: Changing record text and rehashing record/catalogue metadata must not replace original source content. Appended bytes outside all span ranges must also be rejected.
findings.repair: Require exact catalogue text and text hash, validate literal source byte hashes for every span and reconstruct complete content with the explicitly declared newline joiner. Author-declared units preserve their exact original completeness without upgrading machine units.

checks.negative_control_note: Paired in-span mutation rewrites catalogue text and its hash as well as record hash; it reaches literal source byte verification. Separate unbound suffix mutation rewrites all text metadata and fails complete-span conservation.

limits: Frozen producer hash admission remains separate from this pure-helper review.
No full-corpus rebuild, new acquisition, model calls, runtime context assembly or publication performed.
Source semantics of the four additional PIP units are reviewed separately by compact_engine.
